verdict.rationale: Solid's README explicitly states that global state management is built in through Context and Stores, so no third-party library is needed. Its signal primitives give automatic dependency tracking. Community users who have run Solid on real products praise its built-in state handling (deep state, no reducer) and its immediate, debuggable reactivity. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the Store/Context APIs (e.g. nested updates, sharing patterns across the app), and hands-on evidence of large-scale global-store usage beyond brief README and forum claims.
